The issue is clear: when ABOUT opens, it uses the `#dialogue-area` (which keeps the sprite area visible too), so the battle box shows sprite + long text but `overflow: hidden` clips it. The fix is to make the about section use the `#content-panel` (scrollable) like other sections, and hide the sprite when content is open.

Two fixes needed:
1. `openAbout` should use `showContent` (scrollable panel) instead of `dialogue-area`, and hide the sprite
2. When any section opens, hide the sprite to free up vertical space; restore it on close
Now also hide the sprite area when any section opens (and restore on close), so the content panel gets the full battle box height:
Also remove the `max-height: 280px` cap on `#content-panel` so it fills the battle box naturally:

Three changes made:

1. **ABOUT now uses `showContent`** — renders inside the scrollable content panel instead of the fixed dialogue area, so it can scroll if needed
2. **Sprite hides when any section opens** — the full battle box height is freed up for content instead of being split with the 120px sprite
3. **Content panel fills the box** — removed the hard `max-height: 280px` cap, replaced with `flex: 1` so it stretches to fill available space
